style_context: Waterskiing, wakeboarding, lake safety, life jacket fitting, skier signals, and deep-water riding techniques

images.description: Side-by-side instructional comparison of two water-sports start positions on calm lake water: left panel shows a rider on two skis in a compact crouched deepwater-start posture with ski tips up and close together, right panel shows a rider on a wakeboard with both feet attached and the board turned sideways before the pull; clean educational layout, minimal short labels only, no logos or branding
images.value: Shows the distinct body and equipment setup differences between two-ski and wakeboard starts, a side-by-side comparison text alone cannot teach quickly

images.description: Educational cold-water survival diagram of a person floating in a life jacket in the HELP position with knees drawn up, arms folded in close, head above water, and body compact to reduce heat loss; simple side and front views with very short labels only, clean water background, no branding
images.value: Shows the compact body posture of the HELP position, a survival shape that is difficult to picture correctly from prose alone

images.description: Close instructional view of a teenager wearing a Type III water-sports life jacket while checking zipper, chest buckles, side straps, and shoulder fit, with small callouts highlighting snug waist fit, secured closures, and limited ride-up at the shoulders; realistic dockside or boat-ramp setting, no visible logos or words on clothing, minimal labels only
images.value: Shows the exact closure points and snug shoulder-to-waist fit a rider should check before launch, details that text alone cannot demonstrate clearly

images.description: Clean six-panel educational diagram showing standard water-sports hand signals with a single rider silhouette in each panel: skier safe with hands clasped overhead, faster, slower, turn, back to dock, cut motor, plus a separate skier-in-water panel with one ski held upright above the head; plain background, large simple labels only, no branding
images.value: Shows the actual shapes of the standard skier signals, visual forms a Scout must see in order to reproduce and recognize them accurately

images.description: Top-down diagram of a towboat wake pattern on a lake with a rider path beginning outside the wakes, crossing both wakes, returning to the center wake, then repeating the pattern multiple times; clear wake lines, rider arrows, and centerline shown with short labels only, no logos or decorative text
images.value: Shows the repeated outside-to-center wake-crossing path spatially, a movement pattern that prose alone cannot make instantly clear
